Diagonal cutting nippers are specified in ISO 5749 (cited by number); makers of 180-200 mm (7-8 in) high-leverage models state cutting capacities for medium-hard, hard and piano wire (a few millimetres, smallest for piano wire), and soft copper cuts more easily than any of them. The cut is capped at 8 AWG solid copper, 3.26 mm across (the AWG formula, NBS Handbook 100 section 2), a figure chosen for play inside that class.
